blocks.text: **may / might + fe'l** — kelajakda biror narsa **bo'lishi mumkin**, lekin aniq emas: I **might go** to Samarkand next month — Kelasi oy balki Samarqandga borarman. Asosiy shakllar qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 29-dars), hozir va o'tmish haqidagi taxmin esa 29-darsda o'tildi. Bu darsda — kelajak va rejalar bilan bog'liq nozik qo'llanishlar: might be -ing, might have to, may well, might as well va muloyim taklif. O'zbekchada kelajakdagi ehtimol ko'pincha «balki ...-arman», «...ishim mumkin» bilan beriladi. will (fikr) va going to (qaror) dan farqi — might da qaror ham, ishonch ham yo'q:

rows: I think I**'ll stay** at home.
I**'m going to stay** at home.
I **might stay** at home — I'm not sure.

items.text: Take some cash — the card machine **might not work**.
items.translation: Ozgina naqd pul ol — karta terminali **ishlamasligi mumkin**.

items.text: Tom **may come** to the wedding, but he's not sure yet.
items.translation: Tom to'yga **kelishi mumkin**, lekin hali aniq emas.

items.text: I **might sign** up for a Spanish course in September.

blocks.text: **might / may be + -ing** — rejalashtirilayotgan, lekin hali aniq bo'lmagan ish: I **might be going** away next week — Kelasi hafta balki ketarman (gap bo'lyapti, hali aniq emas). Present Continuous kelishilgan rejani bildirgani kabi (→ 19-dars), might be -ing — «ehtimoliy reja». Ko'p hollarda ma'no deyarli farq qilmaydi: I might go / I might be going.

items.text: Aziz **might be coming** to Tashkent next week — he'll call you.
items.translation: Aziz kelasi hafta Toshkentga **kelishi mumkin** — sizga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

items.text: We **may be selling** the car soon, so don't book a service.
items.translation: Yaqinda mashinani **sotishimiz mumkin**, texnik ko'rikka yozilma.

blocks.text: might be able to, might have to, may well

may / might dan keyin boshqa modal fe'l kelmaydi, shuning uchun «might can», «might must» emas — **might be able to** (→ 26-dars), **might have to**, **might need to**. Ehtimol yuqori ekanini ta'kidlash uchun **well** qo'shiladi: It **may well** rain — Yomg'ir yog'ishi ancha ehtimol. **could well** ham shu ma'noda ishlatiladi.

**might as well / may as well** + fe'l — «yaxshiroq varianti yo'q, shuni qila qolaylik». Bu g'ayrat bilan emas, «boshqa iloj yo'q, yo'qotadigan narsa ham yo'q» ohangida aytiladi: The next train is in an hour — we **might as well** walk. O'zbekchada «...a qolaylik», «...sak ham bo'laveradi», «baribir ... ma'qul».

items.text: There's nothing to eat at home, so we **might as well** eat out.
items.translation: Uyda yeydigan hech narsa yo'q, tashqarida **ovqatlana qolaylik**.

items.text: You **may as well** keep the book — I've already read it.
items.translation: Kitobni o'zingda **qoldiraver** — men uni o'qib bo'lganman.

items.text: It's raining anyway, so I **might as well** stay in and study.
items.translation: Baribir yomg'ir yog'yapti, uyda qolib **o'qiy qolay**.

blocks.text: Muloyim maslahat va ruxsat: You might want to ...

**You might want to / You might like to** + fe'l — juda muloyim maslahat: «...sangiz yaxshi bo'lardi», «...sangiz bo'ladi». Ish va rasmiy muloqotda ko'p uchraydi: You **might want to** check the figures again. Rasmiy matnlarda **may** — ruxsat: Visitors **may** park here — Tashrif buyuruvchilar bu yerda to'xtashi mumkin. Ruxsat so'rash (May I ...?) — batafsil 37-darsda.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I might can come» → I **might be able to** come; «We might must wait» → we **might have to** wait; «I maybe will come» → I **might** come yoki **Maybe** I'll come; «might as well» ni «ham» deb tushunish: You **might as well** come = «Kela qolsang ham bo'laveradi», «Siz ham kelishingiz mumkin» emas; «May I to come?» → May I **come**?

might as well ni «boshqa iloj yo'q-ku» iborasi bilan bog'lang: avval sababni ayting (avtobus yo'q, do'kon yopiq), keyin **might as well** + yechim. Kelajakdagi ehtimolda esa o'zingizdan so'rang: «Qaror qildimmi?» Ha → going to; yo'q, faqat imkoniyat → might.

rows: **might be able to / might have to**

examples.title: Future possibility: **may** / **might** + verb
examples.description: Kelajakda bo'lishi mumkin, lekin aniq emas — may / might + fe'l. O'zbekcha «...ishi mumkin», «balki ...-arman».

sentences.text: Take your swimsuit — we **might go** to the pool after lunch.
sentences.translation: Suzish kiyimingni ol — tushlikdan keyin basseynga **borishimiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Jasur **may apply** for a job in Dubai, but he hasn't decided yet.
sentences.translation: Jasur Dubaydagi ishga **hujjat topshirishi mumkin**, lekin hali qaror qilmadi.

sentences.text: The weather forecast says it **might snow** in Tashkent tomorrow night.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, ertaga kechasi Toshkentda qor **yog'ishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I **might not finish** the report today, so don't wait for me.
sentences.translation: Bugun hisobotni **tugatmasligim mumkin**, meni kutmang.

sentences.text: Ticket prices **may rise** again in the spring, according to the airline.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniyaning aytishicha, bahorda chipta narxlari yana **oshishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Sarah **might move** to Edinburgh if she gets the university place.
sentences.translation: Agar universitetga qabul qilinsa, Sara Edinburgga **ko'chishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Be careful with that vase — it **might break** if you put it there.
sentences.translation: U vaza bilan ehtiyot bo'l — u yerga qo'ysang, **sinishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Our team **may not reach** the final if they lose on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Agar shanba kuni yutqazsa, jamoamiz finalga **chiqmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Ask Madina — she **might lend** you her camera for the trip.
sentences.translation: Madinadan so'ra — sayohat uchun fotoapparatini **berib turishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: There **may be** delays on the motorway this weekend because of roadworks.
sentences.translation: Bu dam olish kunlari ta'mirlash ishlari tufayli avtomagistralda **tirbandlik bo'lishi mumkin**.

examples.title: Decided or just possible? **going to**, **will** or **might**
examples.description: Juft-juft: qaror qilingan reja yoki ishonch (going to, be -ing, will) va faqat imkoniyat (might).

sentences.text: I**'m going to buy** a new laptop — I've already chosen the model.
sentences.translation: Yangi noutbuk **olmoqchiman** — modelini allaqachon tanladim.

sentences.text: I **might buy** a new laptop, but it depends on the price.
sentences.translation: Balki yangi noutbuk **olarman**, lekin narxiga bog'liq.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is going to study** law; he's already got a place at university.
sentences.translation: Bekzod huquqshunoslikni **o'qimoqchi**; universitetga allaqachon qabul qilingan.

sentences.text: Bekzod **might study** law, or he **might** do economics — he can't decide.
sentences.translation: Bekzod huquqshunoslikni **o'qishi mumkin**, yoki iqtisodni — hal qila olmayapti.

sentences.text: We**'re having** a party on Saturday — the invitations have gone out.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni ziyofat **qilyapmiz** — taklifnomalar jo'natildi.

sentences.text: We **might have** a party next month, if the flat is ready.
sentences.translation: Kvartira tayyor bo'lsa, kelasi oy **ziyofat qilishimiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: It**'ll** definitely **be** cold in the mountains, so bring a warm coat.
sentences.translation: Tog'da albatta **sovuq bo'ladi**, shuning uchun issiq palto olib kel.

sentences.text: It **might be** windy on the boat, so bring a scarf just in case.
sentences.translation: Qayiqda **shamol bo'lishi mumkin**, ehtiyot uchun sharf olib kel.

sentences.text: Emma **won't come** to the meeting — she's on holiday in Spain.
sentences.translation: Emma yig'ilishga **kelmaydi** — Ispaniyada ta'tilda.

sentences.text: Emma **might not come** to the meeting; she's got a terrible cold.
sentences.translation: Emma yig'ilishga **kelmasligi mumkin**; qattiq shamollagan.

examples.title: Possible plans: **might be doing**; **may well**
examples.description: Ehtimoliy reja — might / may be + -ing. Ehtimol yuqori bo'lsa — may well / might well / could well: «...ishi ancha ehtimol».

sentences.text: I **might be working** late tonight, so don't cook for me.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechgacha **ishlashim mumkin**, menga ovqat pishirma.

sentences.text: Aziz **may be moving** to a bigger flat in the new year.
sentences.translation: Aziz yangi yilda kattaroq kvartiraga **ko'chishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **might be going** to Khiva for the weekend — we'll let you know.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari Xivaga **borishimiz mumkin** — sizga xabar beramiz.

sentences.text: Kate **might be getting** a new job soon, so she's not buying a car yet.
sentences.translation: Keyt tez orada yangi ishga **o'tishi mumkin**, shuning uchun hozircha mashina olmayapti.

sentences.text: The company **may be opening** a branch in Samarkand next year.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya kelasi yil Samarqandda filial **ochishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: It **may well** rain this afternoon — the sky is getting darker.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin yomg'ir **yog'ishi ancha ehtimol** — osmon qorayib boryapti.

sentences.text: You're right. Prices **might well** go up after the new tax.
sentences.translation: To'g'ri aytasiz. Yangi soliqdan keyin narxlar **oshishi ancha ehtimol**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **could well** become the youngest director in the company's history.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kompaniya tarixidagi eng yosh direktor **bo'lishi juda ehtimol**.

sentences.text: The train **may well** be late, so there's no need to rush.
sentences.translation: Poyezd **kechikishi ancha ehtimol**, shuning uchun shoshilishga hojat yo'q.

sentences.text: Oliver **might be coming** with us to the concert, but he isn't sure yet.
sentences.translation: Oliver ham biz bilan konsertga **borishi mumkin**, lekin hali aniq emas.

examples.title: **might be able to**, **might have to**, **might need to**
examples.description: may / might dan keyin can / must kelmaydi — be able to, have to, need to bilan: «-a olishi mumkin», «-ishga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin».

sentences.text: If I finish early, I **might be able to** meet you for lunch.
sentences.translation: Erta tugatsam, siz bilan tushlikda **uchrasha olishim mumkin**.

sentences.text: The trains are on strike, so we **might have to** take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Poyezdlar ish tashlashda, shuning uchun taksiga **o'tirishimizga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Bring your passport — you **might need to** show it at the hotel.
sentences.translation: Pasportingni ol — mehmonxonada **ko'rsatishing kerak bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Madina **might be able to** help you with your Russian homework.
sentences.translation: Madina rus tilidan uy vazifangga **yordam bera olishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: If the situation gets worse, the company **may have to** close two factories.
sentences.translation: Vaziyat yomonlashsa, kompaniya ikkita zavodni **yopishga majbur bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Jasur **might not be able to** come; his flight lands at nine.
sentences.translation: Jasur **kela olmasligi mumkin**; reysi soat to'qqizda qo'nadi.

sentences.text: We **may need to** book the restaurant in advance — it's very popular.
sentences.translation: Restoranni oldindan **band qilishimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin** — u juda mashhur.

sentences.text: Sarah **might have to** work this Saturday because of the deadline.
sentences.translation: Muddat tufayli Sara bu shanba **ishlashga majbur bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: With a bit of luck, they **might be able to** fix the car by tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Omad kulib boqsa, ular mashinani ertagacha **tuzata olishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Patients **may need to** wait a little longer than usual today.
sentences.translation: Bugun bemorlar odatdagidan biroz uzoqroq **kutishlariga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin**.

examples.title: No better option: **might as well**
examples.description: Boshqa yaxshiroq variant yo'q, shuni qila qolaylik — might as well / may as well. O'zbekcha «...a qolaylik», «...sak ham bo'laveradi».

sentences.text: The next bus isn't for an hour, so we **might as well** walk.
sentences.translation: Keyingi avtobus bir soatdan keyin, shuning uchun piyoda **keta qolaylik**.

sentences.text: Nobody's going to use this old sofa — we **may as well** give it away.
sentences.translation: Bu eski divandan hech kim foydalanmaydi — uni **berib yubora qolaylik**.

sentences.text: We've missed the start of the film; we **might as well** go for a coffee instead.
sentences.translation: Film boshlanishini o'tkazib yubordik; o'rniga qahva ichgani **bora qolaylik**.

sentences.text: The shop's closed now. You **might as well** go home and come back tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Do'kon hozir yopiq. Uyga borib, ertaga **qaytib kela qolganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Since you're going to the bazaar anyway, you **might as well** buy some bread.
sentences.translation: Baribir bozorga borayotgan ekansan, non ham **olib qo'ya qol**.

sentences.text: It's only one more stop, so I **may as well** stand.
sentences.translation: Faqat bitta bekat qoldi, **tik tura qolaman**.

sentences.text: Aziz can't sleep anyway, so he **might as well** finish his presentation.
sentences.translation: Aziz baribir uxlay olmayapti, taqdimotini **tugata qolgani yaxshi**.

sentences.text: The meeting is pointless if James isn't coming. We **might as well** cancel it.
sentences.translation: Jeyms kelmasa, yig'ilish ma'nosiz. Uni **bekor qila qolaylik**.

sentences.text: Taxis are so expensive here that you **might as well** rent a car for the week.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda taksi shunchalik qimmatki, bir haftaga mashina **ijaraga ola qolganingiz yaxshi**.

sentences.text: I've already paid for the gym membership, so I **might as well** use it!
sentences.translation: Sport zali a'zoligi uchun pulni to'lab qo'yganman, undan **foydalanganim ma'qul**!

examples.title: Polite advice and permission: **You might want to** ...
examples.description: Muloyim maslahat — You might want to / might like to / might try; rasmiy ruxsat — may.

sentences.text: You **might want to** take an umbrella — it looks like rain.
sentences.translation: Soyabon **olsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi** — yomg'ir yog'adiganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Before the interview, you **might want to** read about the company's history.
sentences.translation: Suhbatdan oldin kompaniya tarixi haqida **o'qib chiqsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: You **might like to** visit the new museum while you're in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda bo'lganingizda yangi muzeyga **borib ko'rsangiz bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Guests **may wish to** use the hotel's free shuttle to the airport.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar mehmonxonaning aeroportgacha bepul avtobusidan **foydalanishlari mumkin**.

sentences.text: If the soup is too spicy, you **might try** adding a little yoghurt.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva juda achchiq bo'lsa, ozgina qatiq qo'shib **ko'rsangiz bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Visitors **may take** photographs, but please don't use a flash.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilar **suratga olishlari mumkin**, lekin chirog'dan foydalanmang.

sentences.text: Kate, you **might want to** check your spelling before you send that email.
sentences.translation: Keyt, u xatni jo'natishdan oldin imloni **tekshirib chiqsang yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Customers **may return** any item within thirty days of purchase.
sentences.translation: Xaridorlar har qanday mahsulotni xariddan keyin o'ttiz kun ichida **qaytarishlari mumkin**.

sentences.text: In my opinion, the company **might consider** offering flexible hours.
sentences.translation: Fikrimcha, kompaniya moslashuvchan ish vaqtini taklif qilishni **ko'rib chiqsa bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Tom, it's late. You **might think** about getting some sleep before your exam.
sentences.translation: Tom, kech bo'ldi. Imtihoningdan oldin biroz uxlab olish haqida **o'ylab ko'rsang bo'lardi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: maybe a summer in London
examples.description: Dilnoza yozda Londonga borishi mumkin: might be going, might have to, might as well, might want to, may be able to.

sentences.text: — Dilnoza, I hear you **might be going** to London this summer?
sentences.translation: — Dilnoza, eshitishimcha, bu yoz Londonga **borishing mumkin** ekan?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **might**, but it depends on whether I get a visa.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **borishim mumkin**, lekin viza olishimga bog'liq.

sentences.text: — The visa process **may take** a while, so apply soon.
sentences.translation: — Viza jarayoni ancha **cho'zilishi mumkin**, shuning uchun tezroq ariza ber.

sentences.text: — I know. I **might have to** wait two months for an appointment.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Navbat uchun ikki oy **kutishimga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — In that case, you **might as well** apply today.
sentences.translation: — Unday bo'lsa, bugunoq **ariza bera qol**.

sentences.text: — You're right. And I **may be able to** stay with my cousin there.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri aytasan. U yerda amakivachchamnikida **qola olishim mumkin**.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! You **might want to** book your flight early, though.
sentences.translation: — Omading bor! Lekin aviachiptani **ertaroq olganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: — Good idea. I **might not** stay the whole summer, anyway.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Baribir butun yoz **qolmasligim mumkin**.

sentences.text: — Why not? You **might** never **get** another chance like this!
sentences.translation: — Nega? Bunday imkoniyat boshqa **bo'lmasligi mumkin**-ku!

sentences.text: — True. I **might** stay longer if I find a summer job.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Yozgi ish topsam, uzoqroq **qolishim mumkin**.

examples.title: Mixed: work, weather and decisions
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kelajakdagi ehtimol, might have to / be able to, may well, might as well va muloyim maslahat.

sentences.text: Experts warn that the river **might flood** if the heavy rain continues.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislarning ogohlantirishicha, kuchli yomg'ir davom etsa, daryo **toshishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Our flight has been cancelled, so we **might as well** book a hotel near the airport.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz bekor qilindi, aeroport yaqinidagi mehmonxonani **band qila qolaylik**.

sentences.text: Aziz **may not be able to** join the team until his contract ends in May.
sentences.translation: Aziz shartnomasi mayda tugamaguncha jamoaga **qo'shila olmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **might be moving** offices next year, but the director hasn't decided yet.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yil ofisimiz **ko'chishi mumkin**, lekin direktor hali qaror qilmadi.

sentences.text: Pack some medicine, because you **might feel** sick on the mountain roads.
sentences.translation: Dori olib ol, chunki tog' yo'llarida ko'ngling **aynishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: If sales don't improve, some staff **might have to** take unpaid leave.
sentences.translation: Savdo yaxshilanmasa, ba'zi xodimlar haq to'lanmaydigan ta'tilga **chiqishga majbur bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: You **might want to** turn your phone off during the ceremony.
sentences.translation: Marosim davomida telefoningizni **o'chirib qo'ysangiz yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **may well** win the competition — her designs are brilliant.
sentences.translation: Nilufar tanlovda **g'olib bo'lishi ancha ehtimol** — uning dizaynlari ajoyib.

sentences.text: The new law **may change** the way small businesses pay tax.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun kichik bizneslarning soliq to'lash tartibini **o'zgartirishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Since there's nothing good on TV, I **might as well** go to bed early.
sentences.translation: Televizorda yaxshi narsa yo'q ekan, erta **yota qolay**.
